lines: What a mess. I had a bad feeling
about this, and I was right.
His arts?
Th-that was one of his techniques?
I'd be just as happy
to get it from you. Don't you think
I'm worth a gift?
Is looking for the Silla Gold Crown
all the rage now? Someone else just
asked me about it.
Tell me, how'd you find
the Silla Gold Crown so fast?
That's right. Here, take this.
I wanna get stronger too.
That's why I want a weapon.
Champion, seek Excalibur! On
Avalon, where the king sleeps,
the sacred sword awaits you!
They say Avalon's just west of here.
Honestly... I get ready to ask,
and off he goes. Every time.
They say he leaped across
seven boats in the
final sea battle. He was trying to
reach the enemy commander's ship.
...Into the strait, still wearing
that splendid armor...
No... Your eyes nearly drew me in.
Is that what it feels like
to turn to stone?
The Medusa Shield was on my mind.
They say it's in the Tasman Sea.
Your eyes brought the story back.
Your deeds are every bit as great
as Charles Martel's, Admiral.
If fear of the blade makes you
hesitate, you could get hurt worse.
You need the nerve to commit.
So the Indian Ocean's
Proof of Conquest comes first!
'Praise be to Allah,
Lord of heaven and earth.
And to our leader, foremost among
those sent to earth...'
A key to the Proof of Conquest
could be hidden there.
